scope: Complete-original-body prerequisite research of fourteen engineering originals, read directly as inert data. No SDK call, deployment, secret access, news retrieval, model training, account change or support upload occurred.
linked_reference_caveat: Only the originals were read. Linked official-evidence registers, implementations, schema contracts, examples, configurations and error guides remain unread. Version, endpoint, production-readiness and quality claims in these originals are source claims, not validated experimental outcomes. Each source's MIT declaration does not replace review of actual task-input and dependency licenses.

sources.workflow: Fetch configured feeds, filter by actual UTC publication window and requested coin or category, rank bounded results and report actual per-feed health separately from matches.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real query and fixed time reference, reviewed source registry and aggregator implementation, compatible feedparser, HTTP and YAML dependencies and rights to reuse actual feed input are required. Live coverage additionally needs network and available approved feeds. Disabled sources and valid cache age must remain explicit rather than assumed fetched.
sources.offline_assessment: Real retained public-feed parsing, filtering or ranking is a plausible offline task after helper and input review. The default runtime lacks the named third-party parsers. Replaying a fixed feed cannot establish latest headlines or present service availability, and a zero-match result is not equivalent to all feeds failing.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Independently verify publication rather than fetch time, future and undated exclusions, exact boundary windows, filter and score semantics, result limits and every feed's fetched, failed or disabled status. Test malformed items and expired cache against the actual contract. Keep ranking claims distinct from market importance or financial predictive value.

sources.workflow: Ground an actual design-to-code pipeline in allowlisted sources, scoped server-only tokens and managed bindings, verify fail-closed behavior and inspect generated artifacts without exposing design or credential content.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual integration source and approved scope, current SDK and scope evidence, reviewed preflight implementation, compatible Node and dependencies, source allowlist and disposable nonproduction inputs are required. Live scope or secret-manager checks need a dedicated authorized sandbox, not host credentials. This source is prerequisite data, not a request to audit this repository or rotate anything.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected actual configuration or server-boundary code fix can be offline with controlled public fixtures and stubbed secret/client access. That establishes local guard behavior only, not real token permissions or cloud key custody. Standard-library Python does not execute the TypeScript integration and no secret store was accessed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check actual missing-secret and browser-context rejection before requests, exact allowlist handling, redacted failure behavior and unchanged known-good output. Independently scan built artifacts rather than relying on an environment check alone. Real minimal scope and rotation outcomes require separate authoritative sandbox evidence; illustrative code with empty-string fallbacks is not automatically fail-closed integration.

sources.workflow: Implement a real typed REST wrapper with validated configuration, mapped errors, bounded retries, paginated iteration and limited-size bulk requests using the actual selected API contract.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual public integration source and desired behavior, reviewed auth setup and API evidence, compatible strict TypeScript, Axios and Zod dependencies are required. Real enrichment requires authorized sandbox identity, credit and data-use scope. No personal contact data or external lead enrichment is needed to test local wrapper behavior.
sources.offline_assessment: Retry, pagination, batching and config logic can be a faithful selected offline code task with stubbed HTTP and frozen public response contracts. The default runtime does not include Node or TypeScript dependencies. Successful stubs cannot establish actual people discovery, enrichment accuracy or current service limits.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Test raw-client error conversion actually reaches retry classification, exact retry counts and delays, page and empty-page termination, partial response handling, batch boundaries and option propagation. Check singleton configuration semantics and credential isolation against actual scope. Source code and production-ready labels are not correctness evidence, especially where illustrative casts or response defaults hide invalid data.

sources.workflow: Produce a source-grounded integration design with explicit tenant and actor boundaries, scoped bulk and webhook flows, checkpoints, data contracts, reconciliation and failure and deletion ownership.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual target system and operator outcome, binding official contract revision, existing architecture evidence, authorized data-scope decisions and clear source and destination authority are required. Live tenant identity and customer permissions matter only when live work is selected. Architecture drafting itself does not need an HR account or actual employee records.
sources.offline_assessment: A real architecture artifact or interface-contract task can be offline using public existing-system inputs and retained first-party evidence after review. The default runtime can produce text but cannot establish production isolation, webhook authenticity or deployed recovery behavior. Missing business decisions must not be silently invented.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Trace actual requirements through all trust and data flows, tenant routing, credential custody, permissions, idempotency, freshness, retention and deletion paths. Independently validate selected API interfaces and assess architecture consistency with a fixed rubric. Diagrams and named controls are not working controls, and a design must not claim deployment or real HR reconciliation.

sources.workflow: Build a deterministic allowlisted incident manifest and minimized diagnostics from an actual receipt, verify redaction and sorted hashes and retain owner, purpose and disposal metadata separately from any approved transmission.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real appropriately public or sanitized incident receipt, exact redaction allowlist, reviewed scanner and artifact contract, scoped output path, recipient and retention deadline are required. The source explicitly permits offline fixtures; a live service account is not universally required. Raw private payloads or real credential values are not study inputs.
sources.offline_assessment: A real redacted-bundle construction or validation task can be offline and potentially standard-library Python after reviewing actual input and helper needs. It does not need Bright Data calls or uploads. A zero-match secret scan is not a universal proof that no sensitive material remains or that the incident is solved.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify only permitted fields survive, secret-bearing paths and content are absent, source-correlated diagnostic values remain useful and sorted manifest hashes match exact retained bytes. Check fail-closed scanner behavior and complete ownership and retention fields. Separate a sealed local bundle from actual private delivery, provider diagnosis and deletion execution.

sources.workflow: Define an actual prediction problem and search budget, validate data, implement split-safe preprocessing and model search and retain evaluated model and export artifacts.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A genuine reusable dataset with target and feature definitions, approved split and metric contract, a chosen compatible AutoML library and dependencies and adequate bounded compute are required. Linked detailed implementation, error and example guides remain unread. A GPU or cloud service is not inherently necessary for every tabular AutoML task.
sources.offline_assessment: An actual small local pipeline task can be offline after reviewing dataset rights and compatible numerical dependencies under the approved expansion. The default standard-library Python runtime lacks the listed AutoML frameworks. Drafted search code or a serialized placeholder cannot establish training, best model selection or held-out performance.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Independently validate no split or target leakage, preprocessing fit only on training data, correct metric and resource bounds and reproducible search artifacts. Recompute held-out predictions and reported metrics on the actual frozen data and validate reload/export behavior. Do not equate tuning-set best score with generalization or a working serving endpoint.

sources.workflow: Inspect an actual SDK integration and binding change evidence, update compatible dependencies and model configuration, compare old and new behavior and expose an explicit gradual-rollout selection.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Real existing integration and tests, exact old and target SDK and model contracts, reviewed release and deprecation evidence and compatible pinned dependencies are required. Real model-output comparison needs separately authorized guarded provider runs and defined quality cases. Latest-install commands and direct SDK examples are inert, not execution instructions.
sources.offline_assessment: A scoped actual config, parsing or SDK-interface migration can be offline against reviewed local dependencies and stub clients. Such tests do not establish changed model quality, cost or live model availability. The default runtime may lack either SDK and no paid request or package upgrade occurred.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check all intended real model references and call-site interfaces without editing unrelated strings, correct bounds and explicit rollout configuration. Verify old and new contract tests and meaningful behavioral comparison when actually authorized. Validate source package and model identifiers rather than copying examples, and keep source-code compatibility distinct from live model-output quality.

sources.workflow: Ground an actual service release in server-only identity and bounded model configuration, independently test streaming and failure behavior in a sandbox and promote or roll back only on recorded thresholds.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual repository, runtime and platform contract, responsible owner and change scope, reviewed current provider evidence and compatible deployment tooling are needed. Real provider checks require explicitly approved sandbox team and key; live release additionally needs actual isolated platform capacity. A local process health check must remain distinct from billable provider readiness.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected real timeout, cancellation, circuit-breaker or deployment-config fix can be offline with controlled public inputs and stubbed provider behavior after review. It cannot establish live streaming through a real proxy, healthy canary traffic or provider latency. The default Python runtime does not supply the hosting platform and no deployment occurred.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify actual key isolation, explicit model and request bounds, local health versus protected provider probe, cancellation, disconnect, buffering, timeout and outage behavior under the chosen harness. Require independent real deployment and rollback evidence for those endpoints. An expected handoff string saying stream pass or canary healthy is an example, not measured success.

sources.workflow: Route the actual ML-engineering request to the named evaluation, integration, modeling, prompt or inventory skill, using inventory as the stated unclear-request default.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: An actual request argument, exact available downstream skill definitions and a functioning dispatcher interface are needed for routing. Full training, evaluation or serving prerequisites are defined by the selected unread skill, not this short role wrapper. An arbitrary broad tool list is not proof of granted tools or resource availability.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected routing classification task can be offline with genuine public request inputs and a fixed independent intent rubric. The default runtime can record routing but not provide the downstream skills or model system. Invoking a skill name is not completion of the user's ML task, and no source wrapper was activated.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check request preservation, branch selection and unclear-input default against the actual intent and available dispatcher contracts. Assess downstream completion independently if that is the claimed endpoint. The original does not specify tie-breaking for mixed requests or error handling, so these must be frozen explicitly rather than assumed from role language.

sources.workflow: Research an actual technical question, extract source-supported recommendations and prepare a correctly scoped actionable issue, with real remote creation only when separately supported and requested.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A concrete topic, genuine primary source evidence, intended repository and label contract and an independent issue-quality rubric are required. Live research needs retrieval tools; actual issue creation needs authorized sandbox repository access and a write-capable interface. The original's read-only declared tools do not by themselves provide its promised remote issue creation.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected issue-draft transformation can be offline using actual public research artifacts and project context. That is not a current web search or a created issue. The default runtime can write text but no issue, label or account was changed and no generic git trigger authorizes publication here.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Verify exact target and label validity, accurate sources and recommendation evidence, concrete acceptance criteria and scope-specific relevance. Distinguish a local draft, submitted issue and independently observed remote issue state. Reject source-summary claims unsupported by actual articles and do not infer publication from a formatted title and body.

sources.workflow: Produce a minimal source-correlated incident bundle with bounded status, environment and timing evidence, exclude meeting and credential data and keep unresolved reproduction failures explicit.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: A real sanitized public incident input and redaction policy, scoped output and support owner, compatible parsing and archive tools and reviewed actual schema are required. Real reproduction needs a separate sandbox test account and synthetic meeting. The later inline script captures recent-meeting and transcript-related responses, which conflicts with the earlier minimization rules and needs adjudication before any task freeze.
sources.offline_assessment: A local allowlisted-manifest or redaction correction can be offline with real public artifacts and compatible tools. Copying or executing the source script is not safe evidence collection and was not done. Stubbed API output can test local handling only, not service connectivity, actual transcript availability or successful reproduction.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check exact allowlisted fields, absence of transcript, participant, token and private-link data in all archive members and errors, deterministic manifest integrity and preservation of meaningful incident status. Distinguish transport errors from HTTP status and inspect suppression of failed commands. A tarball alone cannot establish useful safe diagnostics, delivery or incident resolution.

sources.workflow: Validate actual scraped-document envelopes and provenance, minimize and sanitize permitted content, apply declared extraction constraints and preserve distinct quarantine, normalized and derived stores with bounded retention and deletion lineage.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Real public input artifacts and target-use contract, approved field classification and retention scope, reviewed official SDK and REST envelope evidence and actual storage interfaces are required. Service credentials matter only for selected cloud operations; the original explicitly does not authorize scraping or account changes merely by invocation.
sources.offline_assessment: A local validation, normalization, deduplication or tombstone-code task can be offline with genuine public inputs and reviewed schema and dependencies. Standard-library Python can support some such transformations but does not implement all storage systems. Content hashes are not authorization, and sanitizing Markdown cannot prove all downstream injection or privacy risks are removed.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Check real source and status provenance, malformed and oversized envelopes, canonicalization without losing material identity, actual schema and business constraints and neutralization appropriate to the destination. Verify retention, legal-hold and deletion propagation across every selected derived store. Keep a written policy, emitted tombstone and independently confirmed disposal distinct.

sources.workflow: Build an offline-first contract-test lane for actual GraphQL documents, response and webhook error cases and output controls, with a separate explicitly gated bounded live lane only if requested.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual integration source and named operations, binding GraphQL and webhook specification and vectors, compatible validators and test runner and reviewed first-party evidence are required. Synthetic responses are explicitly intended unit-test inputs, but actual source code and schema must be genuine and reviewed. Live access adds a provisioned sandbox identity and permission gate rather than a universal requirement.
sources.offline_assessment: A real deterministic contract-test or webhook-handling change can be offline with appropriate cached tools. Standard-library Python may handle HMAC cases, while GraphQL validation can require dependencies. Passing these tests does not establish live service behavior, production meeting access or real hosted CI success.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Independently test syntax and variables, partial data, nulls, pagination and throttling, exact raw-byte signatures and replay or duplicate handling, and fail-closed live gating without any credentials. Ensure test assertions catch actual bugs rather than merely restating fixtures. Verify counts, safe artifacts and the selected CI configuration separately from real workflow execution.

sources.workflow: Design a real integration with separate outbound API identity, inbound webhook verification, durable job processing and governed raw and derived stores, including authorized reads, deletion and recovery paths.
sources.explicit_prerequisites: Actual integration goals and repository context, explicit principals, operation and data scope, reviewed current contracts and accountable design decisions are required. A live provider identity is conditional, not needed merely to produce an architecture grounded in public system inputs. Incoming event identity alone does not grant content-fetch authority.
sources.offline_assessment: A selected architecture or interface-contract artifact can be offline using genuine public source and evidence after review. A control-plane diagram or threat-model list does not establish implemented tenant isolation, authentic webhooks or end-to-end disposal. The default runtime can generate text, not deploy or verify the entire service.
sources.independent_verifier_needed: Trace every actor and event through distinct authentication, authorization, idempotency, data-minimization, budget and retention controls and evaluate actual failure and deletion paths. Compare named API and event interfaces with binding evidence and independently assess completeness against real requirements. Separate an internally consistent design from working controls and live operational outcomes.

source_reader: Direct complete-original-body review; exact cohort selection, original hashes, line totals, disjoint IDs and citation bounds independently reconciled by parent.
status_scope: Only original-body prerequisites; linked references, concrete tasks and runtime evidence remain distinct.
